title: Akbar kaha ho aye ali akbar kaha ho tum
body:
MAA ROKE KEHRAHI HAI KE AKBAR KAHA HO TUM, KARBO BALA MEIN JALGAYA SAB GHAR KAHA HO TUM, ZAINAB KE SAR SE CHEEN GAYI CHADAR KAHA HO TUM, AATHARA SAAL WALEY PAYAMBAR KAHA HO TUM, AKBAR KAHA HO AYE ALI AKBAR KAHA HO
TUMABBAS ZEE WEQAR BHI SHAANE KATA CHUKE, ASGHAR GALE PE TEER BHI MAIDAN MEIN KHA CHUKE, ADA GALE PA SHAH KE KHANJAR CHALA CHUKE, NAIZE PA AGAYA SAR-E-SARWAR KAHA HO TUM, AKBAR KAHA HO AYE ALI AKBAR KAHA HO TUM
VEERAN KAR KE MERA BHARA GHAR KIDHAR GAYE, MAA KO AKELA CHOOD KE DILBAR KIDHAR GAYE, AARAAM-E-JAAN-E-ZAINAB-E-MUZTAR KIDHAR GAYE, CHALTE HAIN MAA KE QALB PE KHANJAR KAHA HO TUM
AKBAR KAHA HO AYE ALI AKBAR KAHA HO TUM
<<DIVIDER>>
AAL-E-NABI KA POOCHNE WALA NAHI KOI, BIMAAR-E-KARBALA KA SAHARA NAHI KOI , BE WARISO KA JAG MEIN THIKANA NAHI KOI, SAR PEETTI HAI ZAINAB-E-MUZTAR KAHA HO TUM, AKBAR KAHA HO AYE ALI AKBAR KAHA HO TUM
JOR-O-JAFA KI HUM PA KOI INTEHA NAHI, ABID GHAREEB MARTA HAIN TAP SE DAWA NAHI, SAIDANIYO KE SAR PA BHI DEKHO RIDA NAHI, BALWE MAIN BIBIYA HAIN KHULE SAR KAHA HO TUM, AKBAR KAHA HO AYE ALI AKBAR KAHA HO TUM
NOUHA YE UMME LAILA KE LAB PAR THA AYE HASAN, BETE KE SAAT BUJH GAYI SHAADI KI HAR KIRAN, TAQDEER BAN GAYE MERI RANJ-O-GHAM-O-MEHAN, HUM SHAKLE MUSTUFA ALI AKBAR KAHA HO TUM, AKBAR KAHA HO AYE ALI AKBAR KAHA HO TUM
